def sort_tasks(tasks):
    result = []
    for p in sorted({t["priority"] for t in tasks}):
        group = [t for t in tasks if t["priority"] == p]
        dated = sorted(
            (t for t in group if t["due"] is not None),
            key=lambda t: (t["due"], t["title"]),
        )
        undated = sorted(
            (t for t in group if t["due"] is None),
            key=lambda t: t["title"],
        )
        result.extend(dated)
        result.extend(undated)
    return result

import re


def luhn_valid(number):
    cleaned = re.sub(r"[ -]", "", number)
    if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{12,19}", cleaned) is None:
        return False
    nums = [int(c) for c in cleaned]
    odd = sum(nums[-1::-2])
    even = sum(sum(divmod(d * 2, 10)) for d in nums[-2::-2])
    return (odd + even) % 10 == 0
